subject: Request to shift executive walkthrough to VP time window — proposed coverage plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Executive walkthrough + VP join (proposed time)

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time to set up the product walkthrough next week. Per our last call, you'd like VP-level coverage for the exec portion — I have a short window that should work but want to confirm before sending a calendar update.

Proposed timeline (Pacific):
- 2027-04-14 14:00-14:45 — Exec overview (VP joins for 25–30 min)
- 2027-04-14 14:45-15:30 — Technical deep-dive + Q&A (Karthik leads)

Attached is a lightly updated agenda (agenda_v2.pdf). If that slot doesn't work for your VP, please share alternate windows and whether a backup (SVP or solution engineer) would be acceptable in case of last-minute travel.

Next steps: once you confirm a preferred window I’ll loop in our VP and lock invites.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@brightworks.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: BrightWorks - Sales Ops <salesops@brightworks.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Executive walkthrough + VP join (proposed time)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the agenda — looks good. Our VP (James Reid) will be traveling on the 14th and is only back in the office late on the 13th. Would it be possible to shift the exec portion to the 13th late-afternoon (US/Pacific) or move the whole session to 2027-04-15? If neither works we can accept an SVP as the backup, but James prefers to join if timeline allows.

We could do 2027-04-13 16:30-17:15 PT for the exec overview if that helps. If you need engineered run-through time, we can compress or schedule a separate tech session the same day.

Apologies for the short notice — travel changed last minute.

Best,
Olivia
Olivia Harper
Senior Program Manager, BrightWorks
olivia.harper@brightworks.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-04-11T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Executive walkthrough + VP join (need coverage plan)

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick heads-up: BrightWorks' VP wants to join late on the 13th (16:30 PT) rather than our proposed 14th slot. Travel pushed him back. Two asks:

1) Can Karthik run a compressed technical deep-dive right before or after the exec overview? We could do a staggered 'tiered coverage' where the exec overview is 16:30–17:00 and the deep-dive is 17:00–17:45. That keeps James on for the top-level business conversation and still gives a full tech session.

2) Marissa, if James confirms but then gets delayed again, can you commit to stepping in as the sales VP for the first 15 minutes to maintain momentum? If not, who on the leadership side can cover?

I attached a quick mutual action plan with dates (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) so we can map commitments and deliverables.

Proposed adjusted schedule (Pacific):
- 2027-04-13 16:30–17:00 — Exec overview (James Reid joins)
- 2027-04-13 17:00–17:45 — Tech deep-dive (Karthik)

If this is tight, alternative is to keep the 14th and have James drop in for the first 10–15 min and then hop off — but he prefers the 13th if possible.

Can you both confirm availability? I’ll only update the customer once we have internal confirmations.

Thanks,
Markus

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@brightworks.com>, BrightWorks - Sales Ops <salesops@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: 2027-04-13 16:30 PT — Exec overview + staggered tech deep-dive

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the flexibility. We can accommodate the 2027-04-13 16:30 PT window for James. Finalized plan below (Pacific):

- 16:30–16:55 — Executive overview (James Reid joins; Marissa will open if he is delayed)
- 16:55–17:40 — Technical deep-dive + Q&A (Karthik leads)

Marissa confirmed she can open the meeting for the first 5–10 minutes if James is running late. Karthik is confirmed for the technical portion. I attached the updated agenda and the mutual action plan and will send a calendar invite with separate segments so we can manage timing.

Calendar invite: "Redwood x BrightWorks — Exec + Tech Walkthrough" on 2027-04-13 16:30–17:40 PT (I’ll include the agenda link).

If anything changes on your side, please let me know — otherwise I’ll send the invite and HubSpot activity after this note (deal BW-9421).

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
